sentences.text: The holotype specimen consists of a partial pelvic association and a femur.
This predator possessed short arms with four fingers, a short skull, modest jaw muscles, and short teeth.
The genus name honors the village of Rahioli near the site, while the species name means "from Gujarat" in Latin.
Rahiolisaurus likely possessed a bite force of approximately 3500 Newtons, similar to Allosaurus.
Rahiolisaurus was described in 2010 by Novas and colleagues from fossils found in the Lameta Formation of Gujarat, India.
Remains were collected during expeditions in 1995 and 1997 from a single quarry measuring 50 square meters.
Initial estimates placed the animal at 8 meters long and 2 metric tons, but later allometric estimates suggest a length of 6.22 to 6.75 meters.
Rahiolisaurus lived in an arid to semi-arid landscape with a river, likely providing shrub cover near water.
Dinosaurs in India likely went extinct due to volcanic activity approximately 350,000 years before the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary.
Rahiolisaurus is classified within the family Abelisauridae.

In 2014, paleontologist Thierry Tortosa erected the subfamily Majungasaurinae to separate Rahiolisaurus and related genera from South American abelisaurids based on features like elongated preorbital fenestrae and a sagittal crest widening into a triangular surface.
Recent 2021 analyses place Rahiolisaurus outside the subfamily Majungasaurinae as a basal brachyrostran.
Fossils date to the Maastrichtian stage, between 70 and 66 million years ago, or specifically between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
The animal likely lived in the region of the modern Narmada River Valley.
The Lameta Formation, where fossils were found, is known as a sauropod nesting site with sandy soil.
It is debated whether the Deccan Traps volcanism caused a major adverse climate effect on India's dinosaurs or had relatively mild effects.
It is debated whether abelisaurid migration occurred between Europe and India via Africa or through the Dras-Kohistan volcanic island arc, though these explanations remain questionable.
